payload.title: Controlled PF-E004 fusion
payload.statement: Cross-fitted placement of PF path evidence with the deployment-ready E004 geometry-prefix candidate can retain PF diversity and tail reduction while avoiding the standalone PF subgroup and p90 regressions.
payload.evidence_for: E005 PF residual correlation to E004 is 0.8972483902. Frozen diagnostic blends at 25%, 50%, and 75% PF all improve E004 aggregate RMSE; the 50/50 diagnostic reaches 15.0131171651 with p90 21.7769037293.
payload.evidence_against: The blend weights were inspected after E005 scoring and have no promotion status. Standalone PF fails repeated-map and distribution-shift gates, so naive global blending may still overfit fold composition.
payload.next_test: Pre-register E006 with nested or cross-fit weights/routing, immutable E001 folds, exact E004/PF OOF identities, and unchanged tail, subgroup, shuffled-evidence, runtime, and deployment gates.
